name: Media-Copyright
author: weltenretter

sections.description:
General info

This project contains a wordpress-plugin to handle media copyright data in a tool. Therewith you can edit
– copyright expiration date
– copyright-text
– copyright-url

If copyright is required and any information is missing, there are admin-messages in dashboard an tool-page with hints what is missing.

Setup

To use this plugin upload the zip file to your wordpress-plugins and activate it.
Now you can add copyright information in media detail view.
You can also list all media items with copyright information by using the shortcode:
[wr-media-copyright][/wr-media-copyright]
